name: a cathedral of folding brass
description: A brass structure stands here the size of a wardrobe and the shape of a church seen from a long way off, and it is adding to itself, buttresses and tracery and small saints in small niches, without ever finishing.
looks: It is producing more of itself, tastefully, and at speed.
You look at one square inch of it for about a year and a half.
Underneath all the detail it is exactly what it was, which is the strangest part.
says: It is going very well, thank you for asking.
You are only seeing the first four or five layers.
This is what it does when you are not looking. You are welcome.
emotes: {it} extrudes a spire, considers it, and folds it back in.
Something small and brass detaches from {it}, walks two steps, and rejoins it.
A whole face of {it} refolds into a different order of ornament, silently.
asks: Is the west front too much? Be truthful.
How much of this can you actually hold in your head?
Would you like a window with you in it?
